metricool-mcp.description: Official Metricool Native MCP Server (OAuth 2.0 SSE endpoint at https://ai.metricool.com/mcp). Provides social publishing, scheduling, and multi-network analytics without requiring paid REST API keys.

github-mcp.description: Native GitHub CLI keyring integration authenticated as 'serhatvs' with scopes 'repo', 'read:org', 'workflow', 'gist'. Allows read access to both public and private repositories without manual PAT storage.
